title: Salt on My Lips
prompt:
[Intro: soft muffled kick, grainy chords, distant gulls]

[Verse 1: fragile, close female voice]
Five o'clock, the sand is cold
Nobody's up, nobody's told
I left my shoes beside the gate
Walked in slow, up to my waist

[Chorus: wooden plucked melody, voice doubled]
Salt on my lips
Cold on my skin
I came out here empty
The sea filled me in
Salt on my lips

[Verse 2: a little louder, hi-hat enters]
The sky goes gray, then gray goes gold
A fishing boat, a line unrolled
I don't swim far, I only stand
And let it take what's in my hands

[Chorus: wooden plucked melody, voice doubled]
Salt on my lips
Cold on my skin
I came out here empty
The sea filled me in
Salt on my lips

[Outro: kick fading, small waves, footsteps on sand]
